| 2026-04-16 | main   | Stabilise training: StandardScaler for features + deeper decoder MLPs.                                    | Motivated by gradient starvation observed in the initial 25-epoch run. Both scalers saved as self.scaler / self.static_scaler for future inverse transforms. (2) Decoder Deepening: Replaced single nn.Linear layers in both impute_layer and forecast_layer (src/decoders.py) with 2-layer MLPs: Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim*2) → GELU → Dropout(0.1) → Linear(hidden_dim*2, out_dim). Decoder param count increased from ~390 to 17,414. (3) tune.py refactored to use a make_objective factory with --use_mock_data CLI flag for local integration testing. Local 2-trial Optuna sweep (WANDB_MODE=offline, mock data) completed without errors; best trial val_loss=5.21. Updated test_decoders.py gradient assertion to index into nn.Sequential. | 2026-04-16 | main   | Fix ZINB domain contradiction from StandardScaler + add analysis hooks.                                   | Root cause: StandardScaler converted non-negative traffic counts to signed floats, making target*forecast always non-integer and rarely == 0, which crashed the ZINB NLL and suppressed zero_true_total to 0. (1) Dataset fix: saved self.unscaled_traffic = val_arr.copy() before stacking with weather features; **getitem** now pulls target_forecast from self.unscaled_traffic[idx+seq_len] with .clamp(min=0) guard. Dynamic encoder input still uses scaled self.dynamic_data. (2) Encoder analysis hook: MaskedSpatiotemporalEncoder.forward() accepts return_attention_weights=False; when True, GATv2Conv is called with return_attention_weights=True and (x_spatial, (*, alpha)) is unpacked; returns (x_out, alpha). (3) Pipeline analysis mode: ResilientIoTPipeline.forward() accepts return_analysis=False; when True, encoder is called with return_attention_weights=True and returns {'edge_index', 'edge_weight', 'attention_weights'} without computing loss. (4) train.py logging upgraded: ZeroAcc line now shows [zero_correct/zero_true] raw counts; val_zero_true_count and val_zero_correct_count added to W&B. Verification: 10-epoch run on real Oct 2023 data (53 nodes, 3 days, 23.5% zero-count targets) completed without NaN. zero_true_total=660 per epoch confirms targets are now correct non-negative integers. ZeroAcc=0/660=0.00 is mathematically correct — pi stabilises at ~0.46 because optimal pi for 23.5% structural-zero data is ~0.23, well below the 0.5 threshold; ZeroAcc>0 requires more epochs. All 13 pytest tests pass.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

| 2026-04-21 | main   | Fix Deck.gl updateTriggers rendering bug + establish Vitest testing suite.                                | (1) **Deck.gl fix** (`frontend/src/components/MapVisualizer.tsx`): Root cause was that the ScatterplotLayer was constructed once inside `map.on('load')` — subsequent Zustand `currentTimestep` changes never triggered a re-render because Deck.gl uses shallow reference equality and no `updateTriggers` were set. Fix: store payload/nodeMap in refs; extracted `buildLayers(payload, nodeMap, timestep)` pure function; added a second `useEffect([currentTimestep])` that calls `overlay.setProps({ layers: buildLayers(...) })` on every tick. Added `ArcLayer` for top-60 attention edges (sorted by weight at current timestep). Both layers carry `updateTriggers: { getFillColor: [timestep], getRadius: [timestep] }` (nodes) and `{ getSourceColor, getTargetColor, getWidth, data: [timestep] }` (arcs). Color scale: Green→Yellow→Red mapped to normalised ZINB µ; halo radius scales with uncertainty. `tsc --noEmit` passes (0 errors). (2) **Vitest setup**: installed `vitest@4.1.5 @vitejs/plugin-react jsdom @testing-library/react @testing-library/dom @testing-library/jest-dom vite-tsconfig-paths`; created `frontend/vitest.config.mts` (jsdom env, tsconfigPaths, globals); added `"test": "vitest run"` script to `package.json`. (3) **Test suite** (`frontend/tests/`): `store.test.ts` — 13 tests covering `setTimestep` boundary clamping, `setMaxTimesteps` propagation, `togglePlayback` flip-flop, and `incrementTimestep` wrap-around. `slider.test.tsx` — 9 tests using React Testing Library with mocked Zustand store; verifies slider change dispatches `setTimestep(n)`, play/pause toggling, and correct `min/max/value` attributes. `payload.test.ts` — 11 schema-integrity tests on a synthetic mock payload covering `num_nodes` accounting, `timeseries.length === timesteps`, sequential `t` indices, `attention_sequence` length, unique node IDs, and normalised attention weights ∈ [0,1]. **Result: 33/33 tests pass in 2.5 s.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| 2026-04-29 | main   | Finalise container-isolation strategy: create `Dockerfile.frontend` for the Phase 1 frontend.             | Authored `Dockerfile.frontend` (`node:20-bookworm-slim`, `WORKDIR /workspace/frontend`, `NODE_ENV=development`, `NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1`). Layered build: (1) copy `frontend/package.json` + `frontend/package-lock.json`, (2) `npm ci` to bake all dependencies into the image (Next.js 16.2.4, React 19.2.4, Deck.gl 9.3.1, MapLibre GL 5.23.0, Zustand 5.0.12, Tailwind 4, Vitest 4.1.5 — full lockfile honoured, no host writes), (3) copy the remaining `frontend/` source as a build-time fallback, (4) `EXPOSE 3000`, (5) `CMD ["npm","run","dev","--","-H","0.0.0.0","-p","3000"]` so the Mac host browser can reach the dev server. Compliance: NSTAR_MLOPS.md §1 "Zero Host Download" — packages live exclusively in the image's `node_modules` layer, which docker-compose's anonymous volumes for `/workspace/frontend/node_modules` and `/workspace/frontend/.next` will preserve at runtime against the `./:/workspace` bind mount overlay; NSTAR_FRONTEND_ARCHITECTURE.md §1 tech stack pinned by `frontend/package.json`; NSTAR_PHASES.md "Decoupled Parallelism" — image contains no Python/CUDA/torch and is strictly decoupled from `Dockerfile.cpu` / `Dockerfile.gpu`. Layer-cache ordering (manifest+lockfile before source COPY) keeps incremental rebuilds fast under typical TS/TSX edits. Note: docker-compose.yml does not yet declare a `frontend-dev` service or its anonymous-volume mappings — wiring the service is a follow-up task and is intentionally out of scope here per CLAUDE.md §7 "Piecewise Execution". Outcome: `Dockerfile.frontend` written and ready to be referenced by a `frontend-dev` service in `docker-compose.yml` (next step). (1) `src/pipeline.py` `return_analysis=True` branch now also returns `imputed_features` ([B, N, T, D]); previously dropped via `_, mu, theta, pi = self.decoders(...)`. (2) `src/export_ui_payload.py`: enabled `mask_prob=0.15` (was 0.0 — needed to populate non-trivial mask*series); captured `imputed_features` and `node_mask`; added length-96 per-node arrays `ground_truth_series` (raw counts pulled from `dataset.unscaled_traffic[idx+seq_len-1]`, clamped ≥0; `null` for the 5 simulated nodes), `imputed_series` (last-step traffic channel inverse-transformed via `x_raw = scaled \* dataset.scaler.scale*[0] + dataset.scaler.mean*[0]`— scale=36.5223, mean=23.5619), and`mask_series`(boolean from`node_mask[:,-1,0]`; all-true for simulated nodes). Tripwires: assert `imputed_features.shape == (1, 50, 12, 3)`, assert `scaler.scale*[0] > 0`, assert no NaNs in `imputed_features`, plus per-node post-write assertions on array length and is_simulated invariants. **DESK CHECK** (CLAUDE.md §8) executed and PASSED for window_idx=84, real node id=2 (mask=true at last step): expected `imputed_series[0] = 5.9378`from raw scaled tensor → JSON value`5.9378`(Δ=0.000000); ground_truth`unscaled_traffic[95, 2] = 3.0`matches JSON`3.0`. Mask density measured: 648/4320 = exactly 15.00%. Output: `data/processed/ui_payload.json`5.01 MB, 50 nodes (45 real + 5 simulated), 96 timesteps, 2500 edges. **Frontend.** (1)`types/payload.ts`extended`NodeEntry`with`ground_truth_series: (number\|null)[]`, `imputed_series: number[]`, `mask_series: boolean[]`. (2) `store/useTimeStore.ts`added`selectedNodeId: number\|null = null`, `attentionThreshold: number = 0.05`, with setters; `setAttentionThreshold`clamps to [0,1]. (3)`MapVisualizer.tsx`split into two ScatterplotLayers:`nodes-real` (`stroked:false, filled:true`) and `nodes-simulated` (`stroked:true, filled:false, lineWidthMinPixels:3`) — Deck.gl flags are layer-wide so single-layer was insufficient. Added `onClick`(sets selectedNodeId) on both node layers; map background click clears selection. ArcLayer rewritten: filters by`attention_sequence[t] >= attentionThreshold`; if `selectedNodeId != null`, ego-graph isolation keeps only edges where source==selected or target==selected; otherwise defensive `slice(0, GLOBAL_EDGE_CAP=80)`. `useEffect`deps +`updateTriggers`extended with`selectedNodeId`and`attentionThreshold`. (4) New `NodeInspector.tsx`(right-side floating panel,`position:absolute right:16 top:16 w:360`): renders only when `selectedNodeId != null`; SVG chart (no Recharts dep) overlays ground truth (blue polyline, splits on null) vs imputed (orange polyline) over a length-96 horizontal axis; rose-tinted vertical bands behind masked timesteps; dashed cursor at `currentTimestep`; close button; SIMULATED badge; current-step readout (gt, imputed, µ, σ); embedded threshold slider for live ArcLayer filtering. Defensive degradation: shows "Imputation data unavailable" if arrays missing; clears stale `selectedNodeId`if node not found. (5)`MapScene.tsx`mounts`NodeInspector`via`dynamic({ssr:false})`(Next.js 16 App Router rule). **Verification.**`tsc --noEmit`→ 0 errors. Vitest **43/43 PASS** (was 33; +10 new: 7 store tests for`setSelectedNodeId`and`setAttentionThreshold`clamp/default behaviour, 3 schema tests for length-96 array invariants and simulated-node null/true rules). Phase 1 constraints (PHASES.md) preserved: no live API, static`ui_payload.json` remains the single bridge. |
| 2026-05-01 | main   | Analytics Dashboard & Human-in-the-Loop Telemetry (Phase 1): implement dedicated `/analytics` route, refactor static data bridge to sharded JSON, add UI telemetry pipe, cross-view navigation, and Tab 1 Forecast Variance chart. | **(1) Telemetry Pipe:** Created `frontend/src/app/api/log/route.ts` — POST handler appends timestamped JSON lines to `frontend/frontend_runtime_errors.log`; DELETE handler truncates log to zero bytes (MLOps maintenance). Added `GlobalErrorReporter` client component to `layout.tsx` wiring `window.addEventListener("error")` and `window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection")` to the POST route. Confirmed: `setTimeout(() => { throw new Error("test") }, 0)` produces valid log entries. **(2) Backend Data Sharding:** Refactored `src/export_ui_payload.py` — removed monolithic `OUTPUT_PATH`; now writes `frontend/public/data/master_index.json` (nodes + timeseries + semantic_tags; no imputation arrays) and `frontend/public/data/nodes/node_{id}.json` (zinb_series with μ, θ, σ per timestep; ground_truth, imputed, mask arrays; 1-hop edge lookup). Added explicit ZINB non-negative tripwires `assert (mu > 0).all()` / `assert (theta > 0).all()` and per-field NaN assertions before each file write. Added `load_semantic_tags()` helper loading both `places_cache_test.json` (commercial_density → high/medium/low tags, is_school_zone, highway_proximity) and `google_places_template.csv` (zone_type → `*_zone` tag, nearby_poi_count → poi_density tag); appended `semantic_tags: string[]` to every master_index node entry. **(3) TypeScript Types:** Restructured `payload.ts` — added `ZINBEntry`, `HopEdge`, `NodeDetailPayload` (per-node schema); simplified `NodeEntry` (no imputation); added `MasterIndex` interface; kept `UIPayload = MasterIndex` alias for backwards compat. `semantic_tags` marked optional for defensive rendering against stale payloads. **(4) Frontend Migration:** `MapVisualizer.tsx` migrated to fetch `master_index.json`. `NodeInspector.tsx` replaced monolithic `UIPayload` state with lazy per-node fetch of `node_{selectedNodeId}.json`; stats panel now displays μ, θ, σ from `zinb_series`. **(5) Cross-View Navigation:** Added inline-SVG Fab (bar-chart icon, `bottom: 196, right: 24, z-index: 20`) to `MapScene.tsx` linking to `/analytics`; clears the TimeSlider (`bottom-6` + ~140px height ≈ 164px) with 32px margin. **(6) Analytics Route (`/analytics`):** `frontend/src/app/analytics/page.tsx` — MUI AppBar + Omnibar TextField (filters by name, ID, or POI tag) + MUI X DataGrid (columns: ID, Location, Sim, Avg μ, Peak μ, Avg σ, POI Tags; default sort avg_mu desc; multi-select checkbox). Recharts `ComposedChart` (Tab 1 Forecast Variance): per Amendment 1 uses `<Area dataKey={['ci_lower_{id}', 'ci_upper_{id}']}/>` native range API — floating 95% CI band (1.96σ) requiring no background-colour clipping; `<Line dataKey="mu_{id}"/>` overlaid per selected node. Tabs 2 (Network Influence) and 3 (Self-Healing Log) scaffolded but disabled. **(7) Packages installed inside `frontend-dev` container:** `recharts`, `@mui/x-data-grid`, `@mui/material`, `@mui/icons-material`, `@emotion/react`, `@emotion/styled`. **Rendering confirmed by user: map view stable, analytics DataGrid + Forecast Variance chart render correctly, telemetry log operational.**
